Messages.Author: Keiran
Messages.Body:
Can Pentweret steal an ally, that moved to play by Demdemeh's ability?

Pentweret
Independent: When in combat at close range with an ally that costs less than 4 blood or pool or a vampire with capacity less than 4, Pentweret may give you control of that minion as a strike that costs 2 blood.

Demdemeh
Laibon: If any Gehenna cards are in play during your unlock phase, you may move an animal retainer on Demdemeh to your ready region as an animal ally with 1 strength and 1 bleed. While that animal has more than 2 life, he or she gets +1 strength.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I can't see why not.

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Keiran
Messages.Body: Because the cost of the ally is not defined. Or in this case, it counts as zero?
